evidence: A screen. The films' optics are computed from the protection domain's optical constants and layer sequence with the thin-film recursion taken to oblique incidence; the stack's thermal state from an N-layer model of parallel specular plates; the fleet from the shield study's layout, with tiles held as the dynamics hold them and sunlight attenuated by projected layer counts; the Moon's outgoing infrared from the atmosphere domain's correlated-k model on its titania-stack columns scaled to the GCM design case. No dynamics, attitude law, coating or climate model is run; coatings and the Moon's angular emission are design guesses labelled in assumptions.
reading_rule: Heat on the Moon in W/m2 averaged over the whole Moon (global), its day hemisphere (day) or its night hemisphere (night); PW of sunlight absorbed in the films; temperatures K at the sunward crossing for the ring in the stack's middle. The glow is the films' own emission; the returns are the Moon's own outgoing infrared and reflected sunlight that the films reflect back onto it. Added dimming in percent of the design sunlight (1,173.25 W/m2 at the top of the air, 293.3 W/m2 averaged over the Moon) at the stated infrared efficacy; power from that dimming in TW of electricity at the ledger's 20-30% conversion. Ranges pair low and high design guesses.

assumptions.name: films
assumptions.statement: the comparison's films: 0.1 um of titania on 4 um of silica on the annulus rings, the window stack (1 um on 10 um) on the window rings, both with the protection domain's anti-reflection and matching layers (array_heat, annulus_film)

assumptions.name: optical constants
assumptions.statement: Franta silica and Siefke titania, CXRO below 24.8 nm, Malitson silica without absorption at 210-2,500 nm, as the protection domain evaluates its films

assumptions.name: oblique incidence
assumptions.statement: smooth specular films, s and p averaged; the protection domain's recursion reproduced to 1e-15 at normal incidence

assumptions.name: solar infrared beyond 2.5 um
assumptions.statement: a 5,772 K blackbody's shape scaled so the spectrum gives the solar constant: 45.4 W/m2

assumptions.name: the stack
assumptions.statement: at each point of the sky, the local layers as parallel infinite plates sharing the local absorbed sunlight evenly, no conduction between them; thermal bands 2-125 um, held beyond

assumptions.name: tiles and rings
assumptions.statement: every ring of the layout on the flown matched rings' apolune radius and forced eccentricity by height, the inventory's 28.2 million tiles shared evenly and spaced evenly in time, held perpendicular to the velocity with the 1.5 degree shingle (ring_bundle); keeping tilts left out

assumptions.name: window rings
assumptions.statement: the middle 26% of the stack by height, array_heat's share

assumptions.name: sunlight on each tile
assumptions.statement: attenuated by the films the projected counts put in front (fleet_light's rule), with the Moon's penumbra linear

assumptions.name: layers in the Moon's view
assumptions.statement: along-track tiles over a tile's angular length times rings over a strip's angular width; a rolled stack opens to 1 + (n - 1)|cos roll| layers (design guess)

assumptions.name: the Moon's outgoing infrared
assumptions.statement: the atmosphere domain's correlated-k model on the clear titania-stack columns at 288 and 298 K, interpolated to 294.9 K and scaled to the GCM design case's (1 - 0.280) S/4 = 211.2 W/m2; uniform over the Moon and Lambertian (design guess)

assumptions.name: the Moon's reflected sunlight
assumptions.statement: a Lambertian day side with the planetary albedo 0.28, flat in wavelength, its spectrum the sunlight the window stack passes

assumptions.name: infrared efficacy
assumptions.statement: the dimming that holds the design temperature against the glow is 0.71 of its infrared watts matched as absorbed sunlight (the gases, glow and dimming study's held branch, 13 October); about 0.59 on the corrected radiation of 17 October; efficacy 1, the energy balance alone, is kept beside it

assumptions.name: wide-gap absorber
assumptions.statement: an absorber with a step edge at 220 or 250 nm in the titania's place, 1-2 g/m2, assumed to hold the film's present opacity below 175 nm

assumptions.name: ultraviolet mirror
assumptions.statement: lossless, reflecting 95-98% of 245-390 nm (annulus) or 245-340 nm (window, keeping its spectrum) ahead of the titania; mass from quarter-wave HfO2 (n 2.1) and silica stacks

assumptions.name: heat mirrors and emitters
assumptions.statement: grey opaque coatings of the stated emissivity, sunlight absorbed and taken out of the beam, and mass, anchored to measured coatings (glow_sources.json)

assumptions.name: rolls
assumptions.statement: attitude_schemes' law: zero in the 25 degree service arc and at the nodes, 30 degree cosine ramps; the night roll keeps the night half only

assumptions.name: dimming's electricity
assumptions.statement: 1% of the design sunlight over the Moon's disc is the ledger's dimmer light scaled, at 20-30% conversion

attitude_study.law: outside service, both halves, tilted through the nodes
outside service, both halves, tilted through the nodes
